query: What company traits explain regional clustering?

per_column.name: industry_sector
per_column.rationale: Well-separated, interpretable industry categories that are external to the geographic focus and can be cross-tabulated against regional clusters to reveal, e.g., fintech vs. semiconductor concentration by region.

per_column.name: company_type
per_column.rationale: Clear ordinal/categorical maturity and organization-type segmentation (startup, growth, large enterprise, VC firm) that supports meaningful regional comparison.

per_column.name: primary_tech_domain
per_column.rationale: Interpretable tech-domain buckets external to location; usable for segmentation despite a moderate NULL share. Partially overlaps industry_sector but adds a distinct technical dimension.

per_column.name: deployment_model
per_column.rationale: Categorical and interpretable, but heavily dominated by cloud_saas (128), making it near-constant and limiting the contrast available for regional comparison.

per_column.name: customer_segment
per_column.rationale: Well-separated B2B/B2C/investor/developer categories, external to geography and readily groupable against regional clusters.

per_column.name: product_vs_service_orientation
per_column.rationale: Interpretable product/hardware/platform/services distinction that offers an additional, associational axis for regional comparison.

judge.rationale: As a set, these columns provide multiple external, interpretable categorical dimensions (industry, company type/maturity, tech domain, customer segment, product/service orientation) that can each be grouped and cross-tabulated against regional_cluster to explore what traits associate with regional clustering. Categories are human-readable and well-separated, and none merely restate the geographic focus. The set is somewhat weakened by redundancy (industry_sector, primary_tech_domain, and product_vs_service_orientation overlap conceptually) and by deployment_model being dominated by a single value (cloud_saas), which yields little discriminative contrast. Still, the majority realise the EDA claim well.
